speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Rosea. The normal inflammatory markers, lack of systemic symptoms, and the clinical presentation of multiple lesions with a normal peripheral smear are most consistent with the herald patch and secondary rash of Pityriasis Rosea. The dermoscopy will likely show the characteristic "Christmas tree" pattern or scale patterns confirming this self-limiting viral exanthem.
